title: Public Alert No. 09/2025 – Voluntary Recall of Zovirax IV Infusion by GlaxoSmithKline (GSK) Limited Due to Potential Quality Defects
summary: GSK voluntarily recalled Zovirax IV Infusion 250mg (batch RN3T in Hong Kong) after glass-like particles were found in batch RP8K in Taiwan; both used the same intermediate batch. Particulate contamination can cause phlebitis, pulmonary dysfunction or death. Not listed in NAFDAC d
